217	/-! ## §3 Presentation charts and the point rank -/
218	
219	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
220	
221	open Module CategoryTheory
222	
223	/-- The `appLE` of the identity morphism is the plain restriction map. -/
224	lemma Scheme.id_appLE {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens}
225	    (e : V ≤ (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
226	    (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).appLE U V e =
227	      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V ≤ U from e)).op := by
228	  simp only [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.id_app]
229	  exact Category.id_comp _
230	
231	namespace Scheme.Modules
232	
233	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : X.Modules)
234	
235	/-- The canonical `Γ(X, U)`-module structure on the sections of `G` over a
236	basic open of `U` (restriction of scalars along the restriction map);
237	matches the canonical algebra instance
238	`Scheme.algebra_section_section_basicOpen`. -/
239	noncomputable local instance moduleSectionBasicOpen
240	    {U : X.Opens} (f : Γ(X, U)) :
241	    Module Γ(X, U) Γ(G, X.basicOpen f) :=
242	  Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
243	
244	local instance isScalarTowerSectionBasicOpen {U : X.Opens} (f : Γ(X, U)) :
245	    IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(G, X.basicOpen f) :=
246	  .of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
247	
248	/-- An affine open `V` is an **`e`-presentation chart** for the module `G`
249	if the section module `Γ(G, V)` admits a matrix presentation with `e`
250	generators [Nitsure §4, `n = 0`: the local right-exact presentation
251	`𝒪_V^{⊕m} →ψ 𝒪_V^{⊕e} → F|_V → 0`]. -/
252	def IsPresentationChart (e : ℕ) (V : X.affineOpens) : Prop :=
253	  ∃ mm : ℕ, Nonempty (MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm)
254	
255	variable [G.IsQuasicoherent]
256	
257	/-- The section module of a quasi-coherent module over a basic open, as a
258	matrix presentation: an `e`-generator presentation over an affine open
259	localizes to an `e`-generator presentation over each basic open, with the
260	restricted relation matrix. -/
261	noncomputable def MatrixPresentationBasicOpen {e mm : ℕ} {V : X.affineOpens}
262	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm) (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
263	    MatrixPresentation Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) Γ(G, X.basicOpen f) e mm :=
264	  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
265	  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen G V.2 f
266	  (P.baseChange Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)).congr
267	    (IsLocalizedModule.isBaseChange (Submonoid.powers f) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)
268	      (restrictBasicOpenₗ G f)).equiv
269	
270	@[simp] lemma matrixPresentationBasicOpen_relMatrix {e mm : ℕ}
271	    {V : X.affineOpens} (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm)
272	    (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
273	    (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P f).relMatrix =
274	      P.relMatrix.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom :=
275	  rfl
276	
277	/-- Presentation charts are stable under passing to basic opens. -/
278	theorem IsPresentationChart.basicOpen {e : ℕ} {V : X.affineOpens}
279	    (h : IsPresentationChart G e V) (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
280	    IsPresentationChart G e (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
281	  obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := h
282	  exact ⟨mm, ⟨MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P f⟩⟩
283	
284	/-- The dimension of the fiber of `G` at a point `x` of an affine open
285	chart `V`: the fiber rank of the section module `Γ(G, V)` at the prime of
286	`x` [Nitsure §4: `e = dim_{κ(s)} F(s)`]. -/
287	noncomputable def chartFiberRank {V : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
288	    (hx : x ∈ V.1) : ℕ :=
289	  ((V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank Γ(G, V.1)
290	
291	omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
292	lemma chartFiberRank_congr_chart {V W : X.affineOpens} (h : V = W) (x : X)
293	    (hxV : x ∈ V.1) (hxW : x ∈ W.1) :
294	    chartFiberRank G x hxV = chartFiberRank G x hxW := by
295	  subst h; rfl
296	
297	/-- The chart fiber rank is unchanged by passing to a basic open of the
298	chart. -/
299	theorem chartFiberRank_basicOpen {V : X.affineOpens} (f : Γ(X, V.1))
300	    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ X.basicOpen f) :
301	    chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hx) =
302	      chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hx := by
303	  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
304	  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen G V.2 f
305	  have hloc := Ideal.fiberRank_of_isLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f)
306	    (restrictBasicOpenₗ G f)
307	    (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal)
308	  have hle : X.basicOpen f ≤ (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := X.basicOpen_le f
309	  have h1 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X))
310	    V.1 V.2 (X.basicOpen f) (V.2.basicOpen f) hle hx
311	  rw [Scheme.id_appLE] at h1
312	  have hpt : V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨(𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) x, hle hx⟩ =
313	      V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, X.basicOpen_le f hx⟩ := by
314	    congr 1
315	  have hcomap :
316	      (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).comap
317	          (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)) =
318	        (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, X.basicOpen_le f hx⟩).asIdeal := by
319	    have h2 : algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) =
320	        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom := rfl
321	    rw [h2, ← hpt]
322	    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h1
323	  calc chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hx)
324	      = ((((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).comap
325	          (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f))).fiberRank Γ(G, V.1) :=
326	        Ideal.fiberRank_congr_ideal hcomap.symm
327	    _ = (((V.2.basicOpen f).primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
328	          Γ(G, X.basicOpen f) := hloc.symm
329	    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hx := rfl
330	
331	/-- **Chart-independence of the fiber rank**: two affine charts through the
332	same point give the same fiber rank.  Proof: refine to a common basic open
333	(`exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter`) and localize both sides. -/
334	theorem chartFiberRank_eq {V W : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
335	    (hxV : x ∈ V.1) (hxW : x ∈ W.1) :
336	    chartFiberRank G x hxV = chartFiberRank G x hxW := by
337	  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
338	    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter V.2 W.2 x ⟨hxV, hxW⟩
339	  have hxg : x ∈ X.basicOpen g := by rw [← hfg]; exact hxf
340	  have h1 := chartFiberRank_basicOpen G (V := V) f x hxf
341	  have h2 := chartFiberRank_basicOpen G (V := W) g x hxg
342	  have h3 : chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hxf =
343	      chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen g) x hxg :=
344	    chartFiberRank_congr_chart G (Subtype.ext hfg) x hxf hxg
345	  calc chartFiberRank G x hxV
346	      = chartFiberRank G (V := V) x (X.basicOpen_le f hxf) := rfl
347	    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen f) x hxf := h1
348	    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := X.affineBasicOpen g) x hxg := h3
349	    _ = chartFiberRank G (V := W) x (X.basicOpen_le g hxg) := h2.symm
350	    _ = chartFiberRank G x hxW := rfl
351	
352	variable (X) in
353	/-- The **point rank** of a quasi-coherent module: the dimension of its
354	fiber at the point, computed through any affine chart
355	(`pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank`). -/
356	noncomputable def pointRank (x : X) : ℕ :=
357	  chartFiberRank G x (V := ⟨(exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
358	      (x := x) (U := ⊤) trivial).choose,
359	      (exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤)
360	        trivial).choose_spec.1⟩)
361	    (exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤)
362	      trivial).choose_spec.2.1
363	
364	theorem pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank {V : X.affineOpens} (x : X)
365	    (hx : x ∈ V.1) : pointRank X G x = chartFiberRank G x hx :=
366	  chartFiberRank_eq G x _ hx
367	
368	/-! ## §4 Locality and chart-independence of entry-ideal membership -/
369	
370	omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
371	/-- Restriction of sections is transitive (any parallel pair of `Opens`
372	homs agree, so the composite collapses). -/
373	lemma presheaf_res_res {A B C : X.Opens} (j : B ⟶ A) (i : C ⟶ B)
374	    (k : C ⟶ A) (x : Γ(X, A)) :
375	    X.presheaf.map i.op (X.presheaf.map j.op x) = X.presheaf.map k.op x := by
376	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp,
377	    Subsingleton.elim (i ≫ j) k]
378	
379	/-- Transport of a matrix presentation of the sections of `G` along an
380	equality of opens. -/
381	def transportOpens {U V : X.Opens} (h : U = V) {e mm : ℕ}
382	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(G, U) e mm) :
383	    MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V) Γ(G, V) e mm := h ▸ P
384	
385	omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
386	/-- The entry ideal of a transported presentation is the image of the
387	entry ideal under the `eqToHom` restriction. -/
388	lemma entryIdeal_transportOpens {U V : X.Opens} (h : U = V) {e mm : ℕ}
389	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(G, U) e mm) :
390	    (transportOpens G h P).entryIdeal =
391	      P.entryIdeal.map (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op).hom := by
392	  subst h
393	  simp only [transportOpens, eqToHom_refl, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
394	  exact (Ideal.map_id _).symm
395	
396	variable {e : ℕ}
397	
398	/-- The entry ideal of the basic-open restriction of a presentation is the
399	image ideal of the entry ideal. -/
400	lemma entryIdeal_matrixPresentationBasicOpen {mm : ℕ} {V : X.affineOpens}
401	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm) (f : Γ(X, V.1)) :
402	    (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P f).entryIdeal =
403	      P.entryIdeal.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom := by
404	  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
405	  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen G V.2 f
406	  rw [MatrixPresentationBasicOpen, Module.MatrixPresentation.congr_entryIdeal,
407	    Module.MatrixPresentation.entryIdeal_baseChange]
408	  rfl
409	
410	/-- **Locality of entry-ideal membership on a chart**: if every point of
411	the chart has a basic open on which the restriction of `r` lands in the
412	entry ideal of the restricted presentation, then `r` is in the entry
413	ideal. -/
414	theorem mem_entryIdeal_of_locally {mm : ℕ} {V : X.affineOpens}
415	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm) (r : Γ(X, V.1))
416	    (H : ∀ x ∈ V.1, ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), x ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧
417	      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op r ∈
418	        (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G P g).entryIdeal) :
419	    r ∈ P.entryIdeal := by
420	  classical
421	  choose g hxg hgmem using H
422	  -- the chosen basic opens cover the chart, so the `g x` span the unit
423	  -- ideal
424	  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range fun x : V.1 => g x.1 x.2) = ⊤ := by
425	    rw [← V.2.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff]
426	    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun r => X.basicOpen_le _) fun y hy => ?_
427	    refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
428	      ⟨⟨_, ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩⟩, hxg y hy⟩
429	  refine Submodule.mem_of_span_eq_top_of_smul_pow_mem P.entryIdeal _ hspan r
430	    (fun ⟨_, x, rfl⟩ => ?_)
431	  -- membership after localization at `g x` gives a power `g x ^ n • r ∈ I`
432	  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen (g x.1 x.2)
433	  have h1 := hgmem x.1 x.2
434	  rw [entryIdeal_matrixPresentationBasicOpen] at h1
435	  have h2 : algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (g x.1 x.2)) r ∈
436	      P.entryIdeal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (g x.1 x.2))) := h1
437	  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmem⟩ :=
438	    (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff
439	      (Submonoid.powers (g x.1 x.2)) _ _ _).mp h2
440	  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hs
441	  exact ⟨n, by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hmem⟩
442	
443	omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
444	/-- Restriction along `U ≤ U` is the identity. -/
445	lemma presheaf_map_self {U : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
446	    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r = r := by
447	  rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE h) (𝟙 U), op_id,
448	    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
449	  rfl
450	
451	/-- **Chart-to-chart transfer of the entry-ideal condition**: if the
452	restriction of `r : Γ(X, U)` to a presentation chart `W ≤ U` lies in the
453	entry ideal of `P_W`, then at every point of `W ⊓ V` for a second chart
454	`V ≤ U` there is a basic open of `V` on which the restriction of `r` lies
455	in the entry ideal of the restricted `P_V`.  Presentation-independence of
456	the entry ideal (`Module.MatrixPresentation.entryIdeal_eq`) at a common
457	basic open is the engine. -/
458	theorem exists_basicOpen_mem_entryIdeal_of_chart {U : X.Opens}
459	    (r : Γ(X, U)) {V W : X.affineOpens} (hVU : V.1 ≤ U) (hWU : W.1 ≤ U)
460	    {mmV mmW : ℕ}
461	    (PV : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mmV)
462	    (PW : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, W.1) Γ(G, W.1) e mmW)
463	    (hW : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op r ∈ PW.entryIdeal)
464	    (x : X) (hxV : x ∈ V.1) (hxW : x ∈ W.1) :
465	    ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), x ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧
466	      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op
467	          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op r) ∈
468	        (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G PV g).entryIdeal := by
469	  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
470	    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter W.2 V.2 x ⟨hxW, hxV⟩
471	  have hbofU : X.basicOpen f ≤ U := (X.basicOpen_le f).trans hWU
472	  have hbogU : X.basicOpen g ≤ U := (X.basicOpen_le g).trans hVU
473	  refine ⟨g, hfg ▸ hxf, ?_⟩
474	  -- rewrite the doubly-restricted section as an `eqToHom`-transport of the
475	  -- `W`-side restriction
476	  have hz : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op
477	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op r) =
478	      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hfg.symm).op
479	        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op
480	          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op r)) := by
481	    rw [presheaf_res_res (homOfLE hVU)
482	      (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)) (homOfLE hbogU),
483	      presheaf_res_res (homOfLE hWU)
484	      (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)) (homOfLE hbofU),
485	      presheaf_res_res (homOfLE hbofU)
486	      (eqToHom hfg.symm) (homOfLE hbogU)]
487	  rw [hz,
488	    ← Module.MatrixPresentation.entryIdeal_eq
489	      (transportOpens G hfg (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G PW f))
490	      (MatrixPresentationBasicOpen G PV g),
491	    entryIdeal_transportOpens]
492	  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
493	  rw [entryIdeal_matrixPresentationBasicOpen]
494	  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hW
495	
496	/-! ## §5 The strata ideal -/
497	
498	variable (e) in
499	/-- The rank-`e` **strata ideal** at an affine open `U`: the intersection,
500	over all `e`-generator presentation charts `V ≤ U`, of the preimages of the
501	entry ideals under restriction [Nitsure §4, `n = 0`: the ideal sheaf of the
502	canonical scheme structure on the rank-`e` locus]. -/
503	noncomputable def strataIdeal (U : X.affineOpens) : Ideal Γ(X, U.1) :=
504	  ⨅ (V : X.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1) (mm : ℕ)
505	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm),
506	    P.entryIdeal.comap (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
507	
508	omit [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent G] in
509	lemma mem_strataIdeal_iff {U : X.affineOpens} {r : Γ(X, U.1)} :
510	    r ∈ strataIdeal G e U ↔ ∀ (V : X.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1) (mm : ℕ)
511	      (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm),
512	      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r ∈ P.entryIdeal := by
513	  simp only [strataIdeal, Submodule.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_comap]
514	
515	/-- **Evaluation of the strata ideal on a presentation chart**: on an
516	`e`-presentation chart the strata ideal is the entry ideal of any (hence
517	every) `e`-generator presentation. -/
518	theorem strataIdeal_eq_entryIdeal {V : X.affineOpens} {mm : ℕ}
519	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V.1) Γ(G, V.1) e mm) :
520	    strataIdeal G e V = P.entryIdeal := by

86	private lemma appLE_res_apply' {W W' : Y.Opens} {V : X.Opens}
87	    (e : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h : W' ≤ W) (u : Γ(X, V)) :
88	    (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom ((g.appLE V W e).hom u) =
89	      (g.appLE V W' (h.trans e)).hom u := by
90	  have h1 := congrArg (fun (φ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(Y, W')) => φ.hom u)
91	    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (f := g) e (homOfLE h).op)
92	  simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] using h1
93	
94	/-- Elementwise base-side `appLE` coherence: `appLE` of a restricted base
95	section equals `appLE` from the larger base open. -/
96	private lemma appLE_base_res_apply' {V' V : X.Opens} {W : Y.Opens}
97	    (h : V' ≤ V) (e' : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V') (e : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (u : Γ(X, V)) :
98	    (g.appLE V' W e').hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom u) =
99	      (g.appLE V W e).hom u := by
100	  have h1 := congrArg (fun (φ : Γ(X, V) ⟶ Γ(Y, W)) => φ.hom u)
101	    (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (f := g) e' (homOfLE h).op)
102	  simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] using h1
103	
104	/-- **Matrix presentations pull back to section modules** (the geometric
105	base-change of a local presentation, [Nitsure §4]: "the pulled-back
106	sequence is exact by right-exactness of tensor products").  For a morphism
107	`g : Y ⟶ X`, an affine `V ⊆ X`, an affine `W ⊆ g⁻¹V` and an `ee`-generator
108	presentation `P` of `Γ(G, V)`, the section module `Γ(g^*G, W)` admits an
109	`ee`-generator presentation whose relation matrix is the image of that of
110	`P` under `g.appLE`. -/
111	theorem exists_matrixPresentation_pullback_sections
112	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {W : Y.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
113	    (e : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) {ee mm : ℕ}
114	    (P : MatrixPresentation Γ(X, V) Γ(G, V) ee mm) :
115	    ∃ P' : MatrixPresentation Γ(Y, W)
116	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) ee mm,
117	      P'.relMatrix = P.relMatrix.map (g.appLE V W e).hom := by
118	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) := (g.appLE V W e).hom.toAlgebra
119	  letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) :=
120	    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V W e).hom
121	  obtain ⟨⟨eqv, -⟩⟩ :=
122	    pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g G hW hV e
123	  refine ⟨(P.baseChange Γ(Y, W)).congr eqv, ?_⟩
124	  rw [Module.MatrixPresentation.congr_relMatrix,
125	    Module.MatrixPresentation.baseChange_relMatrix,
126	    RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
127	
128	end PullbackPresentation

130	section FlatBridge
131	
132	/-- Transport of `Module.Flat` between the canonical module structure and a
133	`Module.compHom` structure along a pointwise-identity ring endomorphism
134	(the `appLE` of the identity morphism is the identity restriction, but not
135	definitionally the identity ring hom). -/
136	private lemma flat_compHom_congr {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u}
137	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : R →+* R) (hf : ∀ r, f r = r) :
138	    (letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M f
139	     Module.Flat R M) ↔ Module.Flat R M := by
140	  have h : (Module.compHom M f : Module R M) = ‹Module R M› :=
141	    Module.ext' _ _ fun r m => by
142	      show f r • m = r • m
143	      rw [hf r]
144	  exact (congrArg (fun i : Module R M => @Module.Flat R M _ _ i) h).to_iff
145	
146	variable {T : Scheme.{u}}
147	
148	/-- The `appLE` of the identity morphism at equal opens is pointwise the
149	identity. -/
150	private lemma id_appLE_apply {W : T.Opens}
151	    (e : W ≤ (𝟙 T : T ⟶ T) ⁻¹ᵁ W) (r : Γ(T, W)) :
152	    ((𝟙 T : T ⟶ T).appLE W W e).hom r = r := by
153	  rw [Scheme.id_appLE]
154	  exact presheaf_map_self (X := T) e r
155	
156	/-- **Extraction of section flatness from flatness over the identity**: if
157	`G` is flat over `T` via `𝟙 T` (the encoding of "the coherent sheaf `G` is
158	flat" in `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat`), then the sections over every affine
159	open form a flat module over the section ring. -/
160	theorem flat_sections_of_coherentSheafFlat_id {G : T.Modules}
161	    (h : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T) G) {W : T.Opens}
162	    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) : Module.Flat Γ(T, W) Γ(G, W) :=
163	  (flat_compHom_congr ((𝟙 T : T ⟶ T).appLE W W (le_refl W)).hom
164	    (id_appLE_apply _)).mp (h hW hW (le_refl W))
165	
166	/-- **Flatness over the identity from an affine cover of flat sections**:
167	if the sections of `G` over each member of an affine open cover of `T` are
168	flat over the respective section rings, then `G` is flat over `T` via
169	`𝟙 T`. -/
170	theorem coherentSheafFlat_id_of_charts (G : T.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
171	    {ι : Type u} (Wc : ι → T.Opens) (hWc : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (Wc j))
172	    (hcover : ∀ y : T, ∃ j, y ∈ Wc j)
173	    (hflat : ∀ j, Module.Flat Γ(T, Wc j) Γ(G, Wc j)) :
174	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T) G := by
175	  intro U hU V hV eV
176	  exact flat_section_of_affine_cover (𝟙 T) G Wc hWc Wc hWc
177	    (fun j => le_refl _) hcover
178	    (fun j => (flat_compHom_congr
179	      ((𝟙 T : T ⟶ T).appLE (Wc j) (Wc j) (le_refl _)).hom
180	      (id_appLE_apply _)).mpr (hflat j)) hU hV eV
181	
182	end FlatBridge

184	/-! ## §2 The rank dictionary -/
185	
186	section RankDictionary
187	
188	variable {T : Scheme.{u}} (G : T.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
189	
190	/-- A prime of the section ring of an affine open is the prime ideal of
191	the corresponding point. -/
192	private lemma primeIdealOf_fromSpec {W : T.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
193	    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(T, W)) (hmem : (hW.fromSpec p : T) ∈ W) :
194	    hW.primeIdealOf ⟨hW.fromSpec p, hmem⟩ = p := by
195	  have hinj : Function.Injective hW.fromSpec :=
196	    hW.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
197	  exact hinj (by rw [hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf])
198	
199	/-- **The stalk rank of an affine section module computes the point rank**:
200	for a quasi-coherent `G` with flat, finite sections `Γ(G, W)` over an
201	affine `W`, the rank of `Γ(G, W)` at a prime `p` is the point rank of `G`
202	at the corresponding point `fromSpec p` [Nitsure §4: flatness plus finite
203	presentation make the fibre dimension compute the local rank]. -/
204	theorem rankAtStalk_sections_eq_pointRank {W : T.Opens}
205	    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) [Module.Flat Γ(T, W) Γ(G, W)]
206	    [Module.Finite Γ(T, W) Γ(G, W)] (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(T, W)) :
207	    Module.rankAtStalk Γ(G, W) p = pointRank T G (hW.fromSpec p) := by
208	  have hmem : (hW.fromSpec p : T) ∈ W := by
209	    have h0 : (hW.fromSpec p : T) ∈ Set.range hW.fromSpec :=
210	      Set.mem_range_self p
211	    rwa [hW.range_fromSpec] at h0
212	  rw [Module.rankAtStalk_eq,
213	    pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank G (V := ⟨W, hW⟩) _ hmem]
214	  show p.asIdeal.fiberRank Γ(G, W) = chartFiberRank G _ hmem
215	  rw [chartFiberRank]
216	  exact Ideal.fiberRank_congr_ideal
217	    (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (primeIdealOf_fromSpec hW p hmem)).symm
218	
219	end RankDictionary

221	section PointRankPullback
222	
223	variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
224	
225	/-- **The point rank of a pullback module is the point rank at the image
226	point** (no flatness or finiteness hypotheses; the geometric form of
227	`Ideal.fiberRank_baseChange`): for any morphism `g : Y ⟶ X` and
228	quasi-coherent `G` on `X`,
229	`pointRank (g^*G) y = pointRank G (g y)`. -/
230	theorem pointRank_pullback (y : Y) :
231	    haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g G ‹_›
232	    pointRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) y = pointRank X G (g y) := by
233	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g G ‹_›
234	  -- affine charts around the image point and the point
235	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hgyV, -⟩ :=
236	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := g y) (U := ⊤) trivial
237	  have hyV : y ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V := hgyV
238	  obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW, hWle⟩ :=
239	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := y) (U := g ⁻¹ᵁ V) hyV
240	  -- both sides through the two charts
241	  rw [pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank _ (V := ⟨W, hW⟩) y hyW,
242	    pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank G (V := ⟨V, hV⟩) (g y) hgyV]
243	  -- the section formula for the pullback module over the affine pair
244	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) := (g.appLE V W hWle).hom.toAlgebra
245	  letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) :=
246	    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V W hWle).hom
247	  obtain ⟨⟨eqv, -⟩⟩ :=
248	    pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g G hW hV hWle
249	  -- fiber rank through the equivalence, then base change
250	  have h1 : ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
251	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) =
252	      ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
253	        (TensorProduct Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) Γ(G, V)) :=
254	    Ideal.fiberRank_congr _ eqv.symm
255	  have h2 := Ideal.fiberRank_baseChange (R := Γ(X, V)) (A := Γ(Y, W))
256	    Γ(G, V) ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal)
257	  -- identify the contracted prime with the prime of the image point
258	  have h3 : ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).comap
259	      (algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W)) =
260	      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hgyV⟩).asIdeal := by
261	    have h4 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := g)
262	      V hV W hW hWle hyW
263	    have h5 : algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) = (g.appLE V W hWle).hom := rfl
264	    rw [h5]
265	    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h4
266	  show ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
267	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) =
268	    ((hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hgyV⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank Γ(G, V)
269	  rw [h1, h2]
270	  exact Ideal.fiberRank_congr_ideal h3
271	
272	end PointRankPullback

274	/-! ## §3 Stage D1: unique factorization through the stratum -/
275	
276	section StageD1
277	
278	variable {X T : Scheme.{u}} (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] {e : ℕ}
279	
280	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
281	/-- **The kernel bound** (the hard half of Nitsure's universal property,
282	`n = 0`, [Nitsure §4]: "`f^*𝓕` is locally free of rank `e` iff `f^*ψ = 0`
283	iff `f` factors through `V_e`"): if the pullback of `G` along `q : T ⟶ X`
284	is flat over `T` of constant point rank `e`, then the strata ideal sheaf is
285	contained in the kernel of `q` — every local relation matrix pulls back to
286	the zero matrix, so its entries die in `Γ(T, ·)`. -/
287	theorem strataData_le_ker (hcov : ChartsCover G e) (q : T ⟶ X)
288	    (hflat : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)
289	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G))
290	    (hrank : ∀ t : T,
291	      haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom q G ‹_›
292	      pointRank T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G) t = e) :
293	    strataData G e hcov ≤ q.ker := by
294	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom q G ‹_›
295	  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff.mpr fun U => ?_
296	  intro r hr
297	  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
298	  -- a finite family of `e`-presentation charts covering `U`
299	  obtain ⟨N, Vc, mmc, Pc, hVcU, hcovU⟩ :=
300	    ChartsCover.exists_finite_charts G hcov U
301	  -- the pulled-back section dies on an affine neighbourhood of each point
302	  apply T.IsSheaf.section_ext fun t ht => ?_
303	  obtain ⟨i, hti⟩ := hcovU (q.base t) ht
304	  have htVc : t ∈ q ⁻¹ᵁ (Vc i).1 := hti
305	  obtain ⟨W, hW, htW, hWle⟩ :=
306	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := t) (U := q ⁻¹ᵁ (Vc i).1) htVc
307	  have hV : W ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := fun y hy => hVcU i (hWle hy)
308	  refine ⟨W, hV, htW, ?_⟩
309	  -- the relation matrix of the chart pulls back to zero on `W`
310	  haveI hFlatW : Module.Flat Γ(T, W)
311	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G, W) :=
312	    flat_sections_of_coherentSheafFlat_id hflat hW
313	  obtain ⟨P', hP'⟩ := exists_matrixPresentation_pullback_sections q G
314	    (Vc i).2 hW hWle (Pc i)
315	  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(T, W) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G, W) :=
316	    Module.Finite.of_surjective P'.proj P'.surjective_proj
317	  have h0 : P'.relMatrix = 0 :=
318	    P'.relMatrix_eq_zero_of_flat fun p =>
319	      (rankAtStalk_sections_eq_pointRank _ hW p).trans (hrank _)
320	  -- hence the entry ideal is killed by `q.appLE (Vc i) W`
321	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, (Vc i).1) Γ(T, W) := (q.appLE (Vc i).1 W hWle).hom.toAlgebra
322	  have hker : (Pc i).entryIdeal ≤
323	      RingHom.ker (algebraMap Γ(X, (Vc i).1) Γ(T, W)) :=
324	    (_root_.Module.MatrixPresentation.relMatrix_map_eq_zero_iff
325	      (A := Γ(T, W))).mp (hP' ▸ h0)
326	  -- the strata-ideal condition at the chart
327	  have hmem : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVcU i)).op r ∈ (Pc i).entryIdeal :=
328	    (mem_strataIdeal_iff G).mp hr (Vc i) (hVcU i) (mmc i) (Pc i)
329	  have hzero : (q.appLE (Vc i).1 W hWle).hom
330	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVcU i)).op r) = 0 :=
331	    RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hker hmem)
332	  -- assemble: restriction of `q.app U r` to `W` is `q.appLE (Vc i) W` of
333	  -- the restricted section
334	  have hres : (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom ((q.app U.1).hom r) =
335	      (q.appLE U.1 W hV).hom r := rfl
336	  show (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom ((q.app U.1).hom r) =
337	    (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom 0
338	  rw [map_zero, hres, ← appLE_base_res_apply' q (hVcU i) hWle hV r, hzero]
339	
340	/-- **Unique factorization through the rank-`e` stratum** [Nitsure §4,
341	part (ii), `n = 0` case]: a morphism `q : T ⟶ X` whose pulled-back module
342	is flat over `T` of constant point rank `e` factors uniquely through the
343	closed immersion of the rank-`e` stratum. -/
344	theorem existsUnique_stratumLift (hcov : ChartsCover G e) (q : T ⟶ X)
345	    (hflat : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)
346	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G))
347	    (hrank : ∀ t : T,
348	      haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom q G ‹_›
349	      pointRank T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj G) t = e) :
350	    ∃! l : T ⟶ stratum G e hcov, l ≫ stratumι G e hcov = q := by
351	  have hker : (stratumι G e hcov).ker ≤ q.ker := by
352	    have h1 : (stratumι G e hcov).ker = strataData G e hcov :=
353	      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι (strataData G e hcov)
354	    rw [h1]
355	    exact strataData_le_ker G hcov q hflat hrank
356	  refine ⟨IsClosedImmersion.lift (stratumι G e hcov) q hker,
357	    IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ hker, fun l' hl' => ?_⟩
358	  rw [← cancel_mono (stratumι G e hcov), hl',
359	    IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac]
360	
361	end StageD1
362	
363	/-! ## §4 Stage D2: the stratum pullback is flat -/
364	
365	section StageD2
366	
367	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] {e : ℕ}
368	
369	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
370	/-- **The rank-`e` stratum flattens `G`** [Nitsure §4, `n = 0`: on `V_e`
371	the pulled-back presentation has vanishing relation matrix, so `𝓕|_{V_e}`
372	is free of rank `e`]: the pullback of `G` along the stratum immersion is
373	flat over the stratum. -/
374	theorem coherentSheafFlat_stratum (hcov : ChartsCover G e) :
375	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 (stratum G e hcov))
376	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (stratumι G e hcov)).obj G) := by
377	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (stratumι G e hcov) G ‹_›
378	  -- the chart preimages cover the stratum
379	  have hcover : ∀ z : stratum G e hcov,
380	      ∃ j : {V : X.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart G e V},
381	        z ∈ stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1 := by
382	    intro z
383	    obtain ⟨V, hzV, hchart⟩ := hcov ((stratumι G e hcov).base z)
384	    exact ⟨⟨V, hchart⟩, hzV⟩
385	  -- flat sections on each chart preimage: the pulled-back presentation
386	  -- has vanishing relation matrix, so the section module is free
387	  have hflatj : ∀ j : {V : X.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart G e V},
388	      Module.Flat Γ(stratum G e hcov, stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1)
389	        Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (stratumι G e hcov)).obj G,
390	          stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1) := by
391	    intro j
392	    obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := j.2
393	    obtain ⟨P', hP'⟩ := exists_matrixPresentation_pullback_sections
394	      (stratumι G e hcov) G j.1.2 (j.1.2.preimage (stratumι G e hcov))
395	      le_rfl P
396	    have h0 : P'.relMatrix = 0 := by
397	      rw [hP']
398	      ext a b
399	      simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.zero_apply]
400	      -- the entry lies in the strata ideal, the kernel of `stratumι.app`
401	      have hmem : ((stratumι G e hcov).app j.1.1).hom (P.relMatrix a b) = 0 := by
402	        have h1 : P.relMatrix a b ∈
403	            RingHom.ker (((strataData G e hcov).subschemeι.app j.1.1).hom) := by
404	          rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app]
405	          show P.relMatrix a b ∈ strataIdeal G e j.1
406	          rw [strataIdeal_eq_entryIdeal G P]
407	          exact P.relMatrix_mem_entryIdeal a b
408	        exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp h1
409	      -- `appLE` at `le_rfl` is `app` followed by the trivial restriction
410	      show ((stratumι G e hcov).appLE j.1.1
411	        (stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1) le_rfl).hom (P.relMatrix a b) = 0
412	      have happ : ((stratumι G e hcov).appLE j.1.1
413	          (stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1) le_rfl).hom (P.relMatrix a b) =
414	          ((stratum G e hcov).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_rfl).op).hom
415	            (((stratumι G e hcov).app j.1.1).hom (P.relMatrix a b)) := rfl
416	      rw [happ, hmem, map_zero]
417	    haveI := P'.free_of_relMatrix_eq_zero h0
418	    infer_instance
419	  intro U hU V hV eV
420	  exact coherentSheafFlat_id_of_charts
421	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (stratumι G e hcov)).obj G)
422	    (fun j : {V : X.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart G e V} =>
423	      stratumι G e hcov ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1)
424	    (fun j => j.1.2.preimage (stratumι G e hcov)) hcover hflatj hU hV eV
425	
426	end StageD2
427	
428	/-! ## §5 Stage E: chart supply and the chart locus (noetherian base) -/
429	
430	section ChartSupply
431	
432	/-- Any finitely presented module admits a matrix presentation (the
433	generators of the finitely generated kernel of a finite free surjection
434	are the columns of the relation matrix). -/
435	theorem _root_.Module.FinitePresentation.exists_matrixPresentation
436	    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
437	    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] :
438	    ∃ (ee mm : ℕ), Nonempty (MatrixPresentation R M ee mm) := by
439	  classical
440	  obtain ⟨n, K, eqv, hK⟩ :=
441	    Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin R M
442	  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hK
443	  refine ⟨n, T.card, ⟨MatrixPresentation.congr (N := M) {
444	    relMatrix := Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (T.equivFin.symm j : Fin n → R) i
445	    proj := K.mkQ
446	    surjective_proj := Submodule.mkQ_surjective K

476	a fibre basis; the geometric form of
477	`Module.FinitePresentation.exists_matrixPresentation_of_isLocalizedModule`):
478	on a locally noetherian scheme, every point of a finitely presented module
479	sheaf has an `e`-presentation chart around it with `e` its own point
480	rank. -/
481	theorem exists_presentationChart_mem [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
482	    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (s : S) :
483	    ∃ V : S.affineOpens, s ∈ V.1 ∧
484	      IsPresentationChart F (pointRank S F s) V := by
485	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hsV, -, hfin⟩ := exists_affine_finite_sections_nhds F s ⊤ trivial
486	  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(S, V) :=
487	    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨V, hV⟩
488	  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(S, V) Γ(F, V) := hfin
489	  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(S, V) Γ(F, V) :=
490	    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite _ _

492	    Module.FinitePresentation.exists_matrixPresentation_of_isLocalizedModule
493	      (M := Γ(F, V)) (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨s, hsV⟩).asIdeal
494	  haveI := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen g
495	  haveI := Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen F hV g
496	  obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hloc Γ(S, S.basicOpen g) Γ(F, S.basicOpen g)

498	  have hrank : ((hV.primeIdealOf ⟨s, hsV⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank Γ(F, V) =

501	  refine ⟨S.affineBasicOpen (U := ⟨V, hV⟩) g, ?_, mm, ⟨hrank ▸ P⟩⟩

507	open locus on which the rank-`e` stratum is a closed subscheme

509	noncomputable def chartLocus : S.Opens :=
510	  ⨆ V : {V : S.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart F e V}, V.1.1

514	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {s : S} (h : pointRank S F s = e) :

520	`e`-generator presentation bounds every fibre dimension). -/

523	  obtain ⟨⟨V, hchart⟩, hsV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp h

525	  rw [pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank F (V := V) s hsV]
526	  exact P.fiberRank_le _

532	section FlatPullback
533	
534	/-- **Flatness is stable under arbitrary pullback**: if `G` is flat over
535	`T` (via `𝟙 T`), then `g^*G` is flat over `T'` for any morphism
536	`g : T' ⟶ T` — affine-locally the sections are a base change of a flat
537	module. -/
538	theorem coherentSheafFlat_id_pullback {T' T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T)
539	    (G : T.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
540	    (h : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T) G) :
541	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T') ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) := by
542	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g G ‹_›
543	  -- cover `T'` by affine opens lying over affine opens of `T`
544	  set J := {p : T'.Opens × T.Opens //
545	    IsAffineOpen p.1 ∧ IsAffineOpen p.2 ∧ p.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ p.2} with hJ
546	  have hcover : ∀ t' : T', ∃ j : J, t' ∈ j.1.1 := by
547	    intro t'
548	    obtain ⟨V, hV, hgt', -⟩ :=
549	      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := g.base t') (U := ⊤) trivial
550	    have ht' : t' ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V := hgt'
551	    obtain ⟨W, hW, htW, hWle⟩ :=
552	      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := t') (U := g ⁻¹ᵁ V) ht'
553	    exact ⟨⟨(W, V), hW, hV, hWle⟩, htW⟩
554	  have hflatj : ∀ j : J, Module.Flat Γ(T', j.1.1)
555	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, j.1.1) := by
556	    intro ⟨⟨W, V⟩, hW, hV, hle⟩
557	    haveI : Module.Flat Γ(T, V) Γ(G, V) :=
558	      flat_sections_of_coherentSheafFlat_id h hV
559	    letI : Algebra Γ(T, V) Γ(T', W) := (g.appLE V W hle).hom.toAlgebra
560	    letI : Module Γ(T, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) :=
561	      Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V W hle).hom
562	    obtain ⟨⟨eqv, -⟩⟩ :=
563	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g G hW hV hle
564	    exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv eqv.symm
565	  intro U hU V hV eV
566	  exact flat_section_of_affine_cover (𝟙 T') ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G)
567	    (fun j : J => j.1.1) (fun j => j.2.1) (fun j : J => j.1.1) (fun j => j.2.1)
568	    (fun j => le_refl _) hcover
569	    (fun j => (flat_compHom_congr
570	      ((𝟙 T' : T' ⟶ T').appLE j.1.1 j.1.1 (le_refl _)).hom
571	      (id_appLE_apply _)).mpr (hflatj j)) hU hV eV
572	
573	end FlatPullback

577	variable {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : S.Modules) (e : ℕ) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
578	
579	/-- The restriction of `F` to the chart locus is chart-covered: the charts
580	of `S` inside the chart locus pull back to charts of the open subscheme
581	(the pullback of an `e`-generator presentation is an `e`-generator
582	presentation). -/
583	theorem chartsCover_chartLocus :
584	    ChartsCover ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e := by
585	  intro x
586	  have hx : ((chartLocus F e).ι.base x) ∈ chartLocus F e := by
587	    have h0 : ((chartLocus F e).ι.base x) ∈ Set.range (chartLocus F e).ι :=
588	      Set.mem_range_self x
589	    rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at h0
590	  obtain ⟨⟨V, hchart⟩, hxV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
591	  have hVle : V.1 ≤ (chartLocus F e).ι.opensRange := by
592	    rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
593	    exact le_iSup
594	      (fun W : {V : S.affineOpens // IsPresentationChart F e V} => W.1.1)
595	      ⟨V, hchart⟩
596	  have hpre : IsAffineOpen ((chartLocus F e).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :=
597	    V.2.preimage_of_isOpenImmersion (chartLocus F e).ι hVle
598	  refine ⟨⟨(chartLocus F e).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1, hpre⟩, hxV, ?_⟩
599	  obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hchart
600	  obtain ⟨P', -⟩ := exists_matrixPresentation_pullback_sections
601	    (chartLocus F e).ι F V.2 hpre le_rfl P
602	  exact ⟨mm, ⟨P'⟩⟩
603	
604	/-- The **rank-`e` stratum of `F`**: the canonical closed subscheme of the
605	chart locus cut out by the entry ideals [Nitsure §4, `n = 0`: the closed
606	subscheme `V_e ⊆ V`]. -/
607	noncomputable def rankStratum : Scheme.{u} :=
608	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F ‹_›
609	  stratum ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
610	    (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)
611	
612	/-- The locally closed immersion of the rank-`e` stratum into the base. -/
613	noncomputable def rankStratumι : rankStratum F e ⟶ S :=
614	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F ‹_›
615	  stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
616	    (chartsCover_chartLocus F e) ≫ (chartLocus F e).ι

618	instance : IsImmersion (rankStratumι F e) := by
619	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F ‹_›
620	  show IsImmersion
621	    (stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
622	      (chartsCover_chartLocus F e) ≫ (chartLocus F e).ι)
623	  infer_instance

625	/-- **The support of the rank-`e` stratum is the rank-`e` locus**
626	[Nitsure §4, part (i)]. -/
627	theorem mem_range_rankStratumι_iff [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
628	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (s : S) :
629	    s ∈ Set.range (rankStratumι F e).base ↔ pointRank S F s = e := by
630	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F ‹_›
631	  constructor
632	  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
633	    have hz : (rankStratumι F e).base z = ((chartLocus F e).ι.base)
634	        ((stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
635	          (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)).base z) := rfl
636	    rw [hz, ← pointRank_pullback (chartLocus F e).ι F]
637	    exact (mem_range_stratumι_iff _ (chartsCover_chartLocus F e) _).mp
638	      ⟨z, rfl⟩
639	  · intro h
640	    have hs : s ∈ chartLocus F e := mem_chartLocus_of_pointRank_eq F e h
641	    have hs' : s ∈ Set.range (chartLocus F e).ι := by
642	      rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
643	    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs'
644	    have hrx : pointRank ((chartLocus F e) : Scheme.{u})
645	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) x = e := by
646	      rw [pointRank_pullback (chartLocus F e).ι F x, hx]
647	      exact h
648	    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (mem_range_stratumι_iff _
649	      (chartsCover_chartLocus F e) x).mpr hrx
650	    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
651	    show ((chartLocus F e).ι.base)
652	      ((stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
653	        (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)).base z) = s
654	    rw [show ((stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
655	      (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)).base z) = x from hz, hx]
656	
657	/-- **The rank-`e` stratum flattens `F`** [Nitsure §4, part (i)]: the
658	pullback of `F` along the stratum immersion is flat over the stratum. -/
659	theorem coherentSheafFlat_rankStratum :
660	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 (rankStratum F e))
661	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (rankStratumι F e)).obj F) := by
662	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F ‹_›
663	  intro U hU V hV eV
664	  exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 (rankStratum F e))
665	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
666	      (stratumι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) e
667	        (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)) (chartLocus F e).ι).app F)
668	    (coherentSheafFlat_stratum
669	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F)
670	      (chartsCover_chartLocus F e)) hU hV eV
671

680	/-- **The point rank is bounded on a noetherian scheme**: finitely many
681	presentation charts cover `S` by quasi-compactness, and each caps the rank
682	by its generator count. -/
683	theorem exists_pointRank_le [IsNoetherian S] (F : S.Modules)
684	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ s : S, pointRank S F s ≤ N := by
685	  classical
686	  choose Vc hVc hchart using exists_presentationChart_mem (S := S) F
687	  have hcov : (Set.univ : Set S) ⊆ ⋃ s : S, ((Vc s).1 : Set S) := fun x _ =>
688	    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hVc x⟩
689	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
690	    (fun s : S => ((Vc s).1 : Set S)) (fun s => (Vc s).1.isOpen) hcov
691	  refine ⟨t.sup fun s => pointRank S F s, fun x => ?_⟩
692	  obtain ⟨s, hst, hxs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ x))
693	  calc pointRank S F x ≤ pointRank S F s := by
694	        obtain ⟨mm, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hchart s
695	        rw [pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank F (V := Vc s) x hxs]
696	        exact P.fiberRank_le _
697	    _ ≤ t.sup (fun s => pointRank S F s) := Finset.le_sup hst

700	/-- **The rank fibers of a flat pullback are open** (local constancy of the
701	rank of a flat, finitely presented module, geometrized through `fromSpec`):
702	if `φ^*F` is flat over `T`, the locus where its point rank equals `e` is
703	open in `T`. -/
704	theorem isOpen_pointRank_pullback_eq {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
705	    (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (φ : T ⟶ S)
706	    (hflat : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)
707	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj F)) (e : ℕ) :
708	    haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom φ F inferInstance
709	    IsOpen {t : T | pointRank T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj F) t = e} := by
710	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom φ F inferInstance
711	  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
712	  intro t₀ ht₀
713	  -- affine charts: `V ∋ φ t₀` with finitely presented sections, `W ∋ t₀`
714	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hφt, -, hfin⟩ :=
715	    exists_affine_finite_sections_nhds F (φ.base t₀) ⊤ trivial

723	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := t₀) (U := φ ⁻¹ᵁ V) ht'

726	    flat_sections_of_coherentSheafFlat_id hflat hW

728	    (R := Γ(S, V)) (M := Γ(F, V))

730	  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(T, W)

758	/-! ## §8 Stage E: the universal factorization through a single stratum -/
759	
760	section FactorRankStratum
761	
762	variable {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : S.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
763	
764	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
765	/-- **Unique factorization through the rank-`e` stratum of the base**
766	[Nitsure §4, part (ii), `n = 0`, single-rank case]: a morphism `φ : T ⟶ S`
767	whose pulled-back module is flat with *constant* point rank `e` (measured
768	on the base) factors uniquely through the locally closed immersion
769	`rankStratumι`. -/
770	theorem existsUnique_factor_rankStratum [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
771	    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (e : ℕ) {T : Scheme.{u}} (φ : T ⟶ S)
772	    (hflat : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)
773	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj F))
774	    (hrank : ∀ t : T, pointRank S F (φ.base t) = e) :
775	    ∃! l : T ⟶ rankStratum F e, l ≫ rankStratumι F e = φ := by
776	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (chartLocus F e).ι F inferInstance
777	  -- `φ` lands in the chart locus
778	  have hrange : Set.range φ.base ⊆ Set.range (chartLocus F e).ι.base := by
779	    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
780	    have h1 : φ.base t ∈ chartLocus F e :=
781	      mem_chartLocus_of_pointRank_eq F e (hrank t)
782	    have h2 : (chartLocus F e : Set S) ⊆ Set.range (chartLocus F e).ι.base := by
783	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
784	    exact h2 h1
785	  set q : T ⟶ (chartLocus F e : Scheme.{u}) :=
786	    IsOpenImmersion.lift (chartLocus F e).ι φ hrange with hq
787	  have hqfac : q ≫ (chartLocus F e).ι = φ :=
788	    IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (chartLocus F e).ι φ hrange
789	  -- flatness of the pullback along `q`
790	  have hflat_q : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)
791	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj
792	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F)) := by
793	    intro U hU V hV eV
794	    exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 T)
795	      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp q (chartLocus F e).ι).app F ≪≫
796	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hqfac).app F).symm) hflat hU hV eV
797	  -- constant rank of the pullback along `q`
798	  have hrank_q : ∀ t : T,
799	      haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom q
800	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) ‹_›
801	      pointRank T ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj
802	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F)) t = e := by
803	    intro t
804	    rw [pointRank_pullback q ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartLocus F e).ι).obj F) t,
805	      pointRank_pullback (chartLocus F e).ι F]
806	    have hpt : (chartLocus F e).ι.base (q.base t) = φ.base t := by
807	      have := congrArg (fun m : T ⟶ S => m.base t) hqfac
808	      simpa using this

1434	The rank strata of \cref{lem:flat_locus_open} carry a canonical --- in
1435	general non-reduced --- scheme structure, cut out locally by the ideal of
1436	entries of the relation matrix of a presentation.  This section develops the

1438	generators, the entry ideal, its base-change behaviour, Nitsure's local
1439	universal property, independence of the chosen presentation, and the

1444	\begin{definition}[Matrix presentation]
1445	  \label{def:matrix_presentation}
1446	  \lean{Module.MatrixPresentation}
1447	  \leanok
1448	  \source{nitsure-hilbert-quot}
1449	  A \emph{matrix presentation} of \(M\) by \(e\) generators and \(m\)
1450	  relations consists of a matrix
1451	  \(\psi \in \operatorname{Mat}_{e \times m}(R)\) and a surjection
1452	  \(\pi : R^{\oplus e} \to M\) making the sequence
1453	  \[
1454	    R^{\oplus m} \xrightarrow{\ \psi\ } R^{\oplus e}
1455	      \xrightarrow{\ \pi\ } M \to 0
1456	  \]
1457	  exact.
1458	\end{definition}

1460	\begin{lemma}[Finite presentation]
1461	  \label{lem:matrix_presentation_fp}
1462	  \lean{Module.MatrixPresentation.finitePresentation}
1463	  \leanok

1466	\end{lemma}

1468	\begin{proof}
1469	  \leanok
1470	  \(\pi\) is a surjection from a finite free module whose kernel, the image
1471	  of \(\psi\), is generated by the \(m\) columns of \(\psi\), hence finitely
1472	  generated.

1476	  \label{def:entry_ideal}
1477	  \lean{Module.MatrixPresentation.entryIdeal}

1479	  \uses{def:matrix_presentation}
1480	  \source{nitsure-hilbert-quot}
1481	  The \emph{entry ideal} \(I(\psi) \subseteq R\) of a matrix presentation is
1482	  the ideal generated by the \(e \cdot m\) entries \(\psi_{ij}\) of the
1483	  relation matrix.  It is the ideal of \(1 \times 1\) minors of \(\psi\);
1484	  for an \(e\)-generator presentation this is the Fitting ideal
1485	  \(\operatorname{Fitt}_{e-1}(M)\).

1494	  \(\psi \otimes A \in \operatorname{Mat}_{e \times m}(A)\) vanishes if and

1579	\begin{theorem}[Flat everywhere-rank-\(e\) modules have vanishing relation

1581	  \label{thm:entry_ideal_flat_vanish}
1582	  \lean{Module.MatrixPresentation.relMatrix_eq_zero_of_flat}
1583	  \leanok
1584	  \uses{def:matrix_presentation}
1585	  \source{nitsure-hilbert-quot}
1586	  Let \(M\) carry a matrix presentation \((\psi, \pi)\) by \(e\) generators.
1587	  If \(M\) is flat and \(M_{\mathfrak p}\) has rank \(e\) over
1588	  \(R_{\mathfrak p}\) for every prime \(\mathfrak p\), then \(\psi = 0\).

1701	\begin{theorem}[Nakayama prolongation of a fiber basis]
1702	  \label{thm:nakayama_prolongation}
1703	  \lean{Module.FinitePresentation.exists_matrixPresentation_of_isLocalizedModule}
1704	  \leanok
1705	  \uses{def:matrix_presentation, def:fiber_rank}
1706	  \source{nitsure-hilbert-quot}
1707	  Let \(M\) be finitely presented over \(R\), let \(\mathfrak p \subseteq R\)
1708	  be a prime, and let \(e\) be the fiber rank of \(M\) at \(\mathfrak p\).
1709	  Then there exists \(g \notin \mathfrak p\) such that every localization of
1710	  \(M\) away from \(g\) --- that is, every module \(N\) over an \(R\)-algebra
1711	  \(R'\) realizing the localizations of \(R\) and \(M\) at the powers of
1712	  \(g\) --- admits a matrix presentation by exactly \(e\) generators.
1713	\end{theorem}

1715	\begin{proof}
1716	  \leanok
1717	  \uses{lem:matrix_presentation_fp}
1718	  Every element of the fiber \(\kappa(\mathfrak p) \otimes_R M\) becomes,
1719	  after scaling by some \(r \notin \mathfrak p\) (a unit of
1720	  \(\kappa(\mathfrak p)\)), a pure tensor \(1 \otimes s\) with \(s \in M\):
1721	  this holds for pure tensors \(c \otimes s\) because
1722	  \(\kappa(\mathfrak p)\) is a localization of \(R/\mathfrak p\)-fractions
1723	  (clear the denominator of \(c\)), and sums are handled by scaling both
1724	  summands by the product of their two scalars.  Scaling each vector of a
1725	  basis of the fiber this way produces \(m_1, \dots, m_e \in M\) whose
1726	  images \(1 \otimes m_i\) again form a basis of the fiber (they differ from
1727	  the original basis by unit scalars).

1730	  \(m_i\), and let \(Q := M / \operatorname{im} \alpha\); it is finitely
1731	  generated.  Since the \(1 \otimes m_i\) span the fiber and the tensor
1732	  product is right exact, \(\kappa(\mathfrak p) \otimes_R Q = 0\); as
1733	  \(\kappa(\mathfrak p) \otimes_R Q\) is the fiber of the finite
1734	  \(R_{\mathfrak p}\)-module \(Q_{\mathfrak p}\) at the maximal ideal,
1735	  Nakayama gives \(Q_{\mathfrak p} = 0\).  Hence \(\mathfrak p\) lies
1736	  outside the support of the finite module \(Q\), which is the zero locus
1737	  of its annihilator, so there is \(g \in \operatorname{Ann}(Q)\) with
1738	  \(g \notin \mathfrak p\); thus \(g \cdot M \subseteq
1739	  \operatorname{im} \alpha\).

1741	  Now let \(R'\) and \(N\) realize the localizations of \(R\) and \(M\)
1742	  away from \(g\), with structure map \(l : M \to N\).  The images

1751	  generating family of \(\ker \alpha'\), arranged as the columns of a
1752	  matrix, completes \(\alpha'\) to a matrix presentation of \(N\) by \(e\)
1753	  generators.
1754	\end{proof}

  haveI := hsurj

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffMapKit

/-!
# Functoriality of the WIDENED vehicle along an arbitrary test morphism (R2, residue (b))

The widened vehicle `divFamZarAff` (`…AffVehicle.lean`) is functorial along an **arbitrary**
morphism `f : T' ⟶ T` of test objects: the value of the restricted family at an affine open
`W ⊆ T'.left` — whose `f`-image need not lie in any affine open of `T.left` — is *glued* over a
finite basic-open refinement of `W` subordinate to the preimages of affine opens, using the
widened S5b Zariski keystones through the basic-open toolkit (`…AffMapKit.lean`).

This is the last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): with it the widened carrier of protection
I-0492 is a functor on the whole slice over `Spec k`, which is the generality every DD-R
consumer (`DivRepGlobalData.pull_comp`) is stated at.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.IsPullbackValue` — the characterizing property of the glued
  value, with `pullbackValue_unique` (Zariski separation) and `exists_isPullbackValue`
  (Zariski gluing).
* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.map C n f : divFamZarAff C n T → divFamZarAff C n T'`, with
  `map_id`, `map_comp`, and the no-gluing evaluation `mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality` — over affine tests, `map` along
  `Spec` of an algebra map is `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` of that map under the widened affine
  collapse.

## What is and is not asserted

Everything here is about the Zariski topology of the **base**.  R2 widened the curve side, so
these are the chart-typed proofs of `DivisorFamilyZarMap.lean` with `DivFamZar` replaced by
`DivFamZarAff` — no new geometry, and in particular **no `|P¹(k)|` hypothesis** anywhere in the
statements or their route.  What the widened lane still owes is unchanged by this file: the
subordinate Stacks 0B8B input (residue (a), out of scope per I-0492 clause 2).
-/

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom] {n : ℕ}

namespace divFamZarAff

variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}

/-! ## The characterizing property of the glued value -/

variable (C n) in
/-- The characterizing property of the value at `W` of the restriction of `s` along `f`: on
every affine sub-open of `W` contained in the preimage of an affine open `V` of the target, it
restricts to the base change of the value of `s` at `V`. -/
def IsPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens)
    (v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (W₀ : T'.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (V : T.left.affineOpens)
    (hV : W₀.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) v
      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V)

/-- Values with the pullback property are unique — from the Zariski separation of
`DivFamZarAff` over a basic refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens. -/
theorem pullbackValue_unique {f : T' ⟶ T} {s : divFamZarAff C n T}
    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {v v' : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n}
    (hv : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v) (hv' : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v') :
    v = v' := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (fun w _ => by
      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
  refine eq_of_basic_eq W sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
  rw [hv ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle,
    hv' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle]

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The instance towers over the section rings of the basic refinement exceed the default
-- elaboration budget (as in the chart-typed `divFamZar.exists_isPullbackValue`).
/-- **Existence of the glued value**: the restriction of a compatible family of widened classes
along an arbitrary morphism of test objects has a value at every affine open of the source,
glued over a finite basic-open refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens — the
widened S5b gluing keystone through `divFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
theorem exists_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃ v, IsPullbackValue C n f s W v := by
  classical
  -- the basic refinement subordinate to preimages of affine opens
  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (fun w _ => by
      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens,
      T'.left.basicOpen r ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
    exact ⟨V, hle⟩
  choose Vc hVc using hsub'
  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
    exact inf_le_right
  -- glue the local base changes over the basic refinement
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue_of_basic_compat W sub hspan
    (fun r : ↥sub => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
      (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r.1 r.2).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r.1) (hVc r.1 r.2))
      (s.1 (Vc r.1 r.2)))
    hbmul hbmul'
    (fun r r' => by
      -- the overlap compatibility, from choice independence
      rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
        Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
      exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩) _ _)
  -- the glued value has the pullback property
  refine ⟨z, fun W₀ hW₀ V hV => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T'.left.basicOpen r)
    (fun w hw => by
      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T'.left, W.1)), T'.left.basicOpen r) := by
        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]
        exact hW₀ hw
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hwW
      obtain ⟨hrsub, hwr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hr
      exact ⟨T'.left.basicOpen r, hwr, ⟨r, hrsub, rfl⟩⟩)
  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub₀ hspan₀ (fun q hq => ?_)
  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub₀ q hq
  -- the left side restricts through the glued datum
  have hzr : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
        (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) z
      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
          (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r) (hVc r hr))
          (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := hz ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hL : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le q))
      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) z)
      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen q)
          (hqle.trans (hVc r hr))) (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := by
    rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
      show ((T'.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀ :
          T'.left.basicOpen q ≤ W.1)
        = (hqle.trans (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) from rfl,
      ← Over.resAlgHom_comp T' hqle (T'.left.basicOpen_le r),
      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, hzr, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
      Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
  -- the right side restricts directly
  rw [hL, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
  exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩) _ _

/-- Existence and uniqueness of the glued value. -/
theorem existsUnique_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃! v, IsPullbackValue C n f s W v := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isPullbackValue f s W
  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' => pullbackValue_unique hv' hv⟩

/-! ## The functoriality -/

variable (C n)

/-- The value of the restricted widened family at an affine open of the source. -/
noncomputable def mapVal (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n :=
  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose

lemma mapVal_spec (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
    IsPullbackValue C n f s W (mapVal C n f s W) :=
  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose_spec.1

lemma mapVal_eq_of (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) {W : T'.left.affineOpens}
    {v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n} (hv : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v) :
    mapVal C n f s W = v :=
  pullbackValue_unique (mapVal_spec C n f s W) hv

/-- The value of the restricted widened family on an affine open lying in the preimage of an
affine open is the plain base change — no gluing. -/
lemma mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {V : T.left.affineOpens} (hV : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    mapVal C n f s W
      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 hV) (s.1 V) := by
  have h := mapVal_spec C n f s W W le_rfl V hV
  rwa [Over.resAlgHom_rfl, DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id] at h

/-- **Restriction of the widened vehicle along an arbitrary morphism of test objects** — the
last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): the value at each affine open of the source is the
glued pullback value. -/
noncomputable def map (f : T' ⟶ T) : divFamZarAff C n T → divFamZarAff C n T' :=
  fun s =>
    ⟨fun W => mapVal C n f s W, by
      intro U V h
      beta_reduce
      refine (mapVal_eq_of C n f s (W := U) ?_).symm
      intro W₀ hW₀ V' hV'
      rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp]
      exact mapVal_spec C n f s V W₀ (hW₀.trans h) V' hV'⟩

@[simp]
lemma map_val (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
    (map C n f s).1 W = mapVal C n f s W :=
  rfl

/-- The functor law: restriction along the identity is the identity. -/
theorem map_id (s : divFamZarAff C n T) : map C n (𝟙 T) s = s := by
  refine ext fun W => ?_
  rw [map_val]
  refine mapVal_eq_of C n (𝟙 T) s ?_
  intro W₀ hW₀ V hV
  have hV' : W₀.1 ≤ V.1 := by
    intro p hp
    have hmem := hV hp
    rw [Over.id_left] at hmem
    exact hmem
  rw [Over.appLEAlgHom_id T V.1 W₀.1 hV hV', s.compat W₀ W hW₀, s.compat W₀ V hV']

/-- The functor law: restriction along a composite is the composite of the restrictions. -/
theorem map_comp (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T'' ⟶ T') (s : divFamZarAff C n T) :
    map C n (g ≫ f) s = map C n g (map C n f s) := by
  classical
  refine ext fun W => ?_

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepGlobalLift
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFunctorCompare

/-!
# A DD-R CONSUMER ON THE WIDENED FUNCTOR (R2): `pullGlobal` read at `divFunctorAff`

The widened carrier of protection I-0492 acquired a base-change face (ADDENDUM 8), a Zariski
gluing keystone (§8.6), and finally a functor `divFunctorAff` with a natural transformation
`divFunctorToAff` out of the chart-typed one (ADDENDUM 9).  What it did **not** have, at every
one of those milestones, is a **consumer**: measured at HEAD, the widened names appeared in zero
files outside the `Picard/DivisorFamilyAff*.lean` family.

That is the gap this file closes.  It restates the DD-R general-test pullback
(`DivRepAffinePullback.pullGlobal`, `Picard/DivRepGlobalLift.lean`) on the widened functor and
proves the `pull_comp` law there — the one field of `DivRepGlobalData` that is *about* the
functor rather than about a single test.

## What the restatement costs, and why that is the point

Nothing but a push-forward.  `pullGlobalAff` is `divFamZarToAffVehicle ∘ pullGlobal`, and its
naturality is the chart-typed `pullGlobal_comp` transported along `divFamZarToAffVehicle_map`.
No gluing is redone and no certificate is re-derived over a widened cover.

That cheapness is the substantive claim: it says the widened layer is *usable* by the existing
DD-R stack, not merely well-formed.  A functor nothing consumes and a functor everything can
consume look identical to a sorry census and to a job count.

## Direction, once more

Old → new.  A consumer that already produces a chart-typed section gets its widened counterpart
for free.  The converse does not exist and cannot: by `informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2 /
ADDENDUM 4 §4.3 a straddling divisor at genus `≥ 2` is confined by no fixed pair of `P¹` charts.
So this file does **not** claim the widened functor is representable by `DivOver`; it claims the
chart-typed representability datum pushes forward to a compatible family of widened values.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepAffinePullback.pullGlobalAff` — the widened general-test pullback.
* `…pullGlobalAff_val` — its value at an affine open, `toAff` of the chart-typed one.
* `…pullGlobalAff_comp` — the `pull_comp` law at `divFamZarAff.map`.
* `…divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_pullGlobalAff` — affine consistency, through the widened collapse.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Grassmannian Scheme

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

section Curve

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepGlobalAffLift :
    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
  [IsDominant pi]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
variable (g : ℕ)
variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
  ↥(divisorSections k
    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))

local notation "DivOver" =>
  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)

namespace DivRepAffinePullback

/-! ## The widened general-test pullback -/

-- No `[IsAffineHom pi]` binder here: the file-level `[IsFinite pi]` already implies it, and
-- carrying both made every declaration below report an overlapping-instance warning.

/-- **The widened general-test pullback**: the chart-typed `pullGlobal` pushed forward along the
vehicle comparison of R2.  Its value at an affine open is the widened value of the chart-typed
one, so a consumer that already has the affine package gets the widened section with no extra
input. -/
noncomputable def pullGlobalAff
    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) : divFamZarAff C g T :=
  divFamZarToAffVehicle C g pi
    (pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v)

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- The value of the widened general-test pullback at an affine open. -/
@[simp]
theorem pullGlobalAff_val
    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver)
    (W : T.left.affineOpens) :
    (pullGlobalAff (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v).1 W
      = (D.pull Γ(T.left, W.1) (Over.fromSpecAffine T W ≫ v)).toAff :=
  rfl

/-! ## Naturality in the test object, at the WIDENED functor -/

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- **The `pull_comp` law on the widened functor**: the widened general-test pullback is natural
in the test object, with the *widened* glued restriction `divFamZarAff.map`.

This is the field of `DivRepGlobalData` that is about the functor rather than about one test, and
it is the statement that makes the widened layer consumable.  The proof is the chart-typed
`pullGlobal_comp` transported along the naturality of the vehicle comparison
(`divFamZarToAffVehicle_map`) — no gluing is redone. -/
theorem pullGlobalAff_comp
    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
    pullGlobalAff (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D (f ≫ v)
      = divFamZarAff.map C g f
          (pullGlobalAff (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1)
            (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v) := by
  show divFamZarToAffVehicle C g pi _ = _
  rw [pullGlobal_comp (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D f v,
    divFamZarToAffVehicle_map f]
  -- Both sides are now `divFamZarAff.map C g f` applied to the same term, but the right-hand one
  -- still wears the folded name `pullGlobalAff`.  That unfolding is definitional and `rw`'s
  -- terminal `rfl` runs at reducible transparency only, so it must be discharged explicitly.
  rfl

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- **Affine consistency of the widened pullback**: on an affine test it collapses through the
widened comparison `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` to the widened value of the affine pullback. -/
theorem divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_pullGlobalAff
    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver) :
    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C g A
        (pullGlobalAff (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
          (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D v)
      = (D.pull A v).toAff := by
  rw [pullGlobalAff, divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_toAffVehicle,
    divFamZarAffineEquiv_pullGlobal (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi)
      (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D A v]

end DivRepAffinePullback

end Curve

end AlgebraicGeometry

# THE SEAM PAIR IS INHABITED, AND ITS INHABITANT IS EXACTLY VANISHING `pic⁰`

**Three** roadmap rows defer to one sentence — *"inhabitation of the pair `(huniv V, hcov V)`
is UNMEASURED at every `V` and may be empty everywhere"* — namely `AJCR.w4-rep`,
`…datum.atlas-coupling` and `…datum.chart-restrict`; in Lean the sentence appears verbatim in
exactly one other file, `Pic0ChartSeamCollapse.lean:13`, from which the paragraph you are
reading inherited it.  (**An earlier version of this paragraph said "four rows and three file
headers" and named `Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat`, `Pic0ChartVMonotone` and
`Pic0ChartBotRefute` as carrying it.  A normalized-whitespace search finds it in none of the
three** — `Pic0ChartBotRefute.lean:107` says the materially weaker "no measured inhabitant at
any `V`".  Corrected because inflating the count inflates what this file unblocks.)

Every predecessor result is an *endpoint* result — the pair's coverage clause is refuted at
`V = ⊥`, antecedent 1 is free there, and antecedent 1 is maximal at `V = ⊤` — and
`Pic0ChartSeamCollapse` identifies the pair with `IsIso` of the chart map without exhibiting
or refuting one.

**This file decides it.**  At the chart whose `rep` slot is filled by the landed degree-zero
producer, the pair is *equivalent* to a hypothesis that already has a name elsewhere in the
tree:

  `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f ∧ IsLocallySurjective f  ↔  ∀ S, Subsingleton (pic⁰(S))`

Both directions, with no `V`-restriction, no chart index constraint beyond the free `hdeg` at
parameter `0`, and no hypothesis on the curve beyond its standing package.

## Why this parameter, and why it is not a degenerate dodge

The chart is `abelSigmaChartZero` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroUseSite.lean`), the Abel
chart at parameter `0`, whose `rep` binder is discharged by `divFunctorZeroRepresentableBy`.
Its source is the representing object's underlying scheme — and at parameter `0` that object
is the *terminal* `Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec k))`, so the source is `Spec k` itself and the chart map
sends a point `v : T ⟶ Spec k` to the Σ-element `⟨v, class⟩`.

That shape is what makes both directions cheap, and in *opposite* ways:

* **Antecedent 1 is free**, because the Σ-component of the chart value **is** the point:
  reading it off recovers `v`, so the map is injective on the nose at every test
  (`injective_abelSigmaChartZero_sigmaComponent`).  This is not the `V = ⊥` degeneracy — the source is
  nonempty and the statement is at the unrestricted chart.
* **Antecedent 2 is exactly the vanishing**, because the Σ-component is *surjective* for free
  and the fibre component then has to be hit, which at a singleton `pic⁰` it is
  (`surjective_app_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton`).  Conversely a *second* degree-zero
  class at one test defeats surjectivity, so the vanishing is not merely sufficient
  (`subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_surjective_app`).

So the pair, at this chart, is one hypothesis wearing two hats — and it is the hypothesis
`Picard/Pic0VanishingRoute.lean` produces `JacobianData` from by a route with *none* of the
atlas's antecedents.  The two routes are not alternatives: they close together.

## What is reused rather than rebuilt

`Pic0ChartSeamCollapse.chartIso_of_seam` takes `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` and extracts
injectivity from it via `IsOpenImmersion.le_monomorphisms`.  Here injectivity is available
*directly*, which is strictly less than that antecedent, so the collapse is restated on the
weaker input (`chartIso_of_injective`).  That restatement has an independent payoff, recorded
below as `isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_injective`: **given coverage, antecedent 1 IS plain
elementwise injectivity** — the two-clause `MorphismProperty.relative` reading that
`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion` prices as a fibre-presentation datum collapses to an
injectivity statement once antecedent 2 is in hand.  A lane holding coverage owes injectivity
and nothing more.

## What this does NOT do

* **It does not represent `pic⁰` for a curve of positive genus.**  Mathematically the
  hypothesis is false there, and `not_seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_two_pic0` converts any two
  distinct degree-zero classes over one test into a refutation of the pair.  **But note what
  is and is not landed**: nothing in this tree proves `0 < genus C → ∃ S, ¬ Subsingleton
  (pic0Subgroup C S)`, so the refutation is a *conditional* one awaiting that input, not a
  theorem about positive-genus curves.  (`Picard/Pic0ChartForkNegativeBranch.lean` refutes
  chart-map injectivity at a degree with two sections; that is a statement about `divFamZar`
  sections at parameter `n`, **not** about two `pic0Subgroup` elements, so it does not supply
  this bullet's input either.)
* **It does not supply the vanishing.**  `genus C = 0 → pic0Subgroup C S = ⊥` is real curve
  theory, is the debt `Albanese/Genus0Terminal.lean` isolates, and nothing here proves it.
* **It says nothing about a `V` strictly between `⊥` and `⊤` at a positive-genus curve.**  The
  interval question those three rows ask is answered *at this parameter only*, and there the
  `Opens` lattice of the chart source has no interior to ask about: it is `{⊥, ⊤}`, inhabited
  at `⊤` under the vanishing and refuted at `⊥`.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartIso_of_injective` — the collapse from **plain injectivity** plus
  coverage, weakening `chartIso_of_seam`'s first input.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_injective` — **given coverage, antecedent 1
  is elementwise injectivity.**  Chart-free, divisor-free, curve-free.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.sigmaComponent_abelSigmaChartZero` — the Σ-component of the terminal
  chart's value is the point itself.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.injective_abelSigmaChartZero_sigmaComponent` — **antecedent 1's elementwise content,
  unconditionally**, at the unrestricted chart.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_app_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` /
  `subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_surjective_app` — surjectivity **is** the vanishing, both ways.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` — the chart is an isomorphism
  of presheaves under the vanishing.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_subsingleton` — **THE INHABITANT**: both
  seam antecedents at once.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_iff` — **the decision**, as an iff.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.not_seamPair_abelSigmaChartZero_of_two_pic0` — the refutation at any
  curve with two distinct degree-zero classes at one test.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallySurjective_abelSigmaChartZero_iff` — **the sharp form**:
  antecedent 2 *alone* is the equivalence; antecedent 1 rides free on both sides.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_representableBy_pic0TypeFunctor_of_subsingleton` — **the producer
  fires**: `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` actually runs on this input, across the
  `Sigma.desc` gap that the pair statement alone does not cross.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_mono_of_cov` — **the repricing
  at arbitrary parameter**, and the most reusable statement here: with `Mono D.hom`, coverage
  implies antecedent 1 for the general Abel chart at any `n`.
-/

/-! ## The collapse on the weaker input

`Pic0ChartSeamCollapse.chartIso_of_seam` derives elementwise injectivity from antecedent 1.
Everything after that step uses only the injectivity, so the same proof runs from it — and
that matters here because the terminal chart has injectivity *without* having antecedent 1
